result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but there is one major content issue: an untranslated localization key is displayed as a section heading. The rest of the layout (header, promo banner, carousels, restaurant cards, bottom nav) appears visually consistent.

issues.description: The section heading shows the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of translated text, breaking the UI copy.
issues.suggestion: Fix the localization resource so the key resolves to proper text such as 'Popular near you', and add a fallback so raw keys never render in production.
